title: A resolution of Erdős Problem 1061 on the sum-of-divisors function
summary: We resolve Erdős Problem 1061, the question whether the number \[ S(x)=\#\{(a,b)\in\mathbb{N}^2:a+b\le x, \ σ(a)+σ(b)=σ(a+b)\} \] of ordered solutions has a linear asymptotic $S(x)\sim cx$. In fact the opposite extreme holds at every fixed logarithmic scale: for every \(R>0\), \[ \lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{S(x)}{x(\log x)^R}=+\infty. \] The construction begins with three integers having the same abundancy index and reduces the divisor-sum identity to two equations in six primes.
